rows.en:
GitFocus helps developers stay productive by rewarding coding with app access. Block distracting apps until you commit code to GitHub.

HOW IT WORKS
• Add one or more GitHub accounts (no sign-in required)
• Select apps to block during focus sessions
• Each new GitHub contribution earns you 5 minutes of unlock time
• Need emergency access? Use a life to unlock until midnight

KEY FEATURES

Commit-Based Rewards
Every time your GitHub contribution graph increases, you earn unlock time for your blocked apps. The more you code, the more time you earn.

Smart App Blocking
Uses iOS Screen Time to block apps you choose. No workarounds - the apps are truly blocked until you earn time or use a life.

Lives System
Start with 1 free life. Use it for emergency access when you need to check something urgent. Earn more lives by building your coding streak.

Time Borrowing
Need to quickly finish a message? Borrow up to 5 minutes. Your future commits will pay it back automatically.

Contribution Graph
See your GitHub activity at a glance. Watch your coding streak grow as you stay focused and productive.

Privacy First
We only read your public contribution graph (no access to your repositories or code). Your data is stored on your device, with optional iCloud sync for certain settings/statistics if iCloud is enabled.

PERFECT FOR
• Developers who want to reduce social media time
• Students learning to code
• Anyone building a coding habit
• Teams doing focus sprints

Break the doom-scrolling cycle. Start coding, start earning.

Note: Requires a public GitHub profile with visible contributions.
rows.value:
GitFocus pomaže programerima da ostanu produktivni tako što kodiranje nagrađuje pristupom aplikacijama. Blokirajte aplikacije koje vas ometaju dok ne napravite commit na GitHub.

KAKO RADI
• Dodajte jedan ili više GitHub naloga (prijava nije potrebna)
• Izaberite aplikacije koje želite da blokirate tokom fokus sesija
• Svaki novi GitHub doprinos donosi 5 minuta vremena za otključavanje
• Treba vam hitan pristup? Iskoristite život za otključavanje do ponoći

KLJUČNE FUNKCIJE

Nagrade zasnovane na commit-ima
Svaki put kada se vaš GitHub grafikon doprinosa poveća, dobijate vreme za otključavanje blokiranih aplikacija. Što više kodirate, više vremena dobijate.

Pametno blokiranje aplikacija
Koristi iOS Screen Time za blokiranje aplikacija koje izaberete. Nema zaobilaženja - aplikacije su zaista blokirane dok ne zaradite vreme ili iskoristite život.

Grafikon doprinosa
Pogledajte GitHub aktivnost na prvi pogled i filtrirajte je po nalogu ili godini.

Privatnost na prvom mestu
Čitamo samo vaš javni grafikon doprinosa. Nemamo pristup vašim repozitorijumima ili kodu.

Napomena: Potreban je javni GitHub profil sa vidljivim doprinosima.

rows.value: Imate pitanje, prijavu greške ili zahtev za funkciju?

rows.en: We'd love to hear from you.
Do I need to connect my GitHub account?
rows.value: Da li treba da povežem svoj GitHub nalog?

rows.en: No! GitFocus only needs the GitHub username or usernames you choose to track. We read public contribution graphs (the green squares on profiles) to detect commits. No OAuth, no tokens, no passwords required.
rows.value: Ne! GitFocus-u su potrebna samo GitHub korisnička imena koja odaberete za praćenje. Čitamo javne grafike doprinosa (zelene kvadrate na profilima) da bismo otkrili commit-ove. Nije potreban OAuth, tokeni ili lozinke.

rows.en: You can add multiple GitHub accounts and decide which ones count toward commit detection.
rows.value: Možete dodati više GitHub naloga i odlučiti koji se uzimaju u obzir za otkrivanje commit-ova.

rows.en: Why do you need Screen Time permissions?
rows.value: Zašto su vam potrebne Screen Time dozvole?

rows.en: GitFocus uses Apple's Screen Time API to block apps. This is the same secure system that powers Apple's built-in parental controls. We need permission to apply app restrictions on your behalf.
rows.value: GitFocus koristi Apple-ov Screen Time API za blokiranje aplikacija. Ovo je isti sigurni sistem koji pokreće ugrađenu roditeljsku kontrolu od Apple-a. Potrebna nam je dozvola da primenimo ograničenja aplikacija u vaše ime.

rows.en: Does GitFocus work with private repositories?
rows.value: Da li GitFocus radi sa privatnim repozitorijumima?

rows.en: Yes! GitHub counts all commits (public and private) in your contribution graph by default. As long as your contribution settings are set to show "Private contributions," we'll see them.
rows.value: Da! GitHub po podrazumevanom broji sve commit-ove (javne i privatne) u vašem grafiku doprinosa. Sve dok su podešavanja doprinosa postavljena da prikazuju "Privatne doprinose", videćemo ih.

rows.en: Go to your GitHub profile → Contribution settings → Check "Private contributions"
rows.value: Idite na svoj GitHub profil → Podešavanja doprinosa → Označite "Privatni doprinosi"

rows.en: How much time does each commit earn?
of unlock time. Push 3 commits? That's 15 minutes to scroll Twitter guilt-free.
rows.value: vremena otključavanja. Poslali 3 commit-a? To je 15 minuta za pregledanje Twitter-a bez krivice.

rows.en: What are "Lives" and how do they work?
Lives are emergency unlocks. When you use a life, all your blocked apps are unlocked until midnight. You start with 1 free life and can earn more through streaks:
rows.value: Životi su hitna otključavanja. Kada iskoristite život, sve vaše blokirane aplikacije se otključavaju do ponoći. Počinjete sa 1 besplatnim životom i možete zaraditi više kroz serije:

rows.en: Then +1 life every month you maintain the streak
rows.value: Zatim +1 život svakog meseca dok održavate seriju

rows.en: Need to finish a quick message but don't have unlock time? You can borrow up to 5 minutes. This creates "debt" that gets paid back from your future commit earnings.
rows.value: Treba da završite brzu poruku, ali nemate vremena otključavanja? Možete pozajmiti do 5 minuta. Ovo stvara "dug" koji se vraća iz vaših budućih zarada od commit-ova.

rows.en: Example: You borrow 3 minutes. Your next commit earns 5 minutes, but 3 go to pay off debt, leaving you with 2 minutes.
rows.value: Primer: Pozajmite 3 minuta. Vaš sledeći commit donosi 5 minuta, ali 3 idu na otplatu duga, ostavljajući vam 2 minuta.

rows.en: The Discipline Bank tracks time you've earned but haven't used. It's a measure of your self-control. Each minute you earn but don't spend on distractions goes into your bank.
rows.value: Banka discipline prati vreme koje ste zaradili, ali niste iskoristili. To je mera vaše samokontrole. Svaki minut koji zaradite, ali ne potrošite na distrakcije, ide u vašu banku.

rows.en: Challenge yourself: How many minutes can you bank by the end of the year?
rows.value: Izazovite sebe: Koliko minuta možete uštedeti do kraja godine?

rows.en: What are the streak milestone rewards?
rows.value: Koje su nagrade za prekretnice serija?

rows.en: Building a streak unlocks permanent perks:
Weekly time bank (unused time resets weekly instead of daily)
rows.value: Nedeljna banka vremena (neiskorišćeno vreme se resetuje nedeljno umesto dnevno)
Trajno vreme (zarađeno vreme nikada ne ističe)

rows.en: Here are some things to check:
rows.value: Evo nekoliko stvari koje treba proveriti:

rows.en: Make sure your GitHub username is entered correctly
rows.value: Uverite se da je vaše GitHub korisničko ime pravilno uneto

rows.en: If you use multiple accounts, check that the right accounts are enabled for commit detection
rows.value: Ako koristite više naloga, proverite da su pravilni nalozi omogućeni za otkrivanje commit-ova

rows.en: Check that your commits show up on your GitHub profile's contribution graph
rows.value: Proverite da se vaši commit-ovi prikazuju na grafiku doprinosa vašeg GitHub profila

rows.en: If using private repos, ensure "Private contributions" is enabled in GitHub settings
rows.value: Ako koristite privatne repozitorijume, uverite se da je "Privatni doprinosi" omogućeno u GitHub podešavanjima

rows.en: Wait a few minutes — GitHub's contribution graph can take time to update
rows.value: Sačekajte nekoliko minuta — grafik doprinosa na GitHub-u može da zahteva vreme za ažuriranje

rows.en: Granted Screen Time permissions during setup
rows.value: Dali Screen Time dozvole tokom podešavanja

rows.en: Selected at least one app or category to block
rows.value: Izabrali najmanje jednu aplikaciju ili kategoriju za blokiranje

rows.en: Started a focus session from the main screen
rows.value: Pokrenuli sesiju fokusiranja sa glavnog ekrana

rows.en: If issues persist, try going to iOS Settings → Screen Time and ensure GitFocus has the necessary permissions.
rows.value: Ako se problemi nastavljaju, pokušajte da odete u iOS Podešavanja → Screen Time i uverite se da GitFocus ima potrebne dozvole.

rows.en: The app crashed or is behaving unexpectedly
rows.value: Aplikacija se srušila ili se ponaša neočekivano

rows.en: Force quit and reopen the app
rows.value: Primorajte zatvaranje i ponovo otvorite aplikaciju

rows.en: Make sure you're on the latest version of GitFocus
rows.value: Uverite se da ste na najnovijoj verziji GitFocus-a

rows.en: If the issue persists, email us at
rows.value: Ako se problem nastavi, pošaljite nam email na
sa detaljima o onome što se dogodilo

rows.value: Kako da resetujem ili počnem ispočetka?

rows.en: Delete the app from your device
Note: Your GitHub username or account list is stored securely for convenience, so it may be pre-filled when you reinstall.
rows.value: Napomena: Vaše GitHub korisničko ime ili lista naloga su bezbedno pohranjeni radi pogodnosti, tako da mogu biti unapred popunjeni kada ponovo instalirate.

rows.en: Pull down on the main screen to manually refresh your commit data from GitHub.
rows.value: Povucite nadole na glavnom ekranu da ručno osvežite vaše podatke o commit-ovima sa GitHub-a.

rows.en: Go to iOS Settings → Screen Time → GitFocus to verify permissions are granted.
rows.value: Idite u iOS Podešavanja → Screen Time → GitFocus da proverite da li su dozvole date.

rows.en: Visit github.com/[your-username] and check that your contribution graph shows recent commits.
rows.value: Posetite github.com/[vaše-korisničko-ime] i proverite da vaš grafik doprinosa prikazuje nedavne commit-ove.

Tell us what you'd like to see
rows.value: Recite nam šta biste želeli da vidite

rows.en: Review the translations and suggest fixes
GitFocus Privacy Policy. We don't collect your data. Everything stays on your device.
rows.value: GitFocus Privacy Policy. We don't collect your data. Everything stays on your device.

rows.en: We built GitFocus with privacy as a core principle. Here's exactly what we do (and don't do) with your information.
rows.value: Napravili smo GitFocus sa privatnošću kao osnovnim principom. Evo tačno šta radimo (i ne radimo) sa vašim informacijama.

rows.en: We don't collect your data. Period.
GitFocus does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data to our servers because we don't have any servers to send it to.
rows.value: GitFocus ne prikuplja, ne čuva niti prenosi bilo kakve lične podatke na naše servere jer nemamo servere za njihov prenos.

rows.en: Everything the app needs to function is stored locally on your device:
rows.value: Sve što je aplikaciji potrebno za rad čuva se lokalno na vašem uređaju:

rows.en: Your GitHub username or usernames (to check public commits)
rows.value: Vaše GitHub korisničko ime ili imena (za proveru javnih commit-ova)

rows.en: Your earned time and streak data
rows.value: Podaci o zarađenom vremenu i seriji

rows.en: GitFocus reads public GitHub contribution data for the username or usernames you add to determine when you've made commits. Here's how it works:
rows.value: GitFocus čita javne GitHub podatke o doprinosu za dodata korisnička imena da bi utvrdio kada ste napravili commit-ove. Evo kako funkcioniše:

rows.en: Your public contribution graph (the green squares)
Commit counts per day (not commit contents)
rows.value: Broj commit-ova po danu (ne sadržaj commit-ova)
Bilo koji GitHub API sa autentifikacijom

rows.en: We intentionally designed GitFocus to work without GitHub authentication. You can add one or multiple GitHub usernames, and we only read publicly available information that anyone can see by visiting those GitHub profiles.
rows.value: Namerno smo dizajnirali GitFocus da radi bez GitHub autentifikacije. Možete dodati jedno ili više GitHub korisničkih imena, a mi čitamo samo javno dostupne informacije koje svako može videti posetom tih GitHub profila.

rows.en: GitFocus uses Apple's Screen Time API (Family Controls framework) to block apps. This is the same secure system that powers Apple's built-in Screen Time features.
rows.value: GitFocus koristi Apple-ov Screen Time API (Family Controls framework) za blokiranje aplikacija. Ovo je isti sigurni sistem koji pokreće ugrađene Screen Time funkcije od Apple-a.

rows.en: App blocking is handled entirely by iOS, not our code
rows.value: Blokiranje aplikacija u potpunosti obrađuje iOS, a ne naš kod

rows.en: We never see which apps you use or for how long
rows.value: Nikada ne vidimo koje aplikacije koristite niti koliko dugo

rows.en: Apple's privacy protections apply to all Screen Time data
rows.value: Apple-ova zaštita privatnosti primenjuje se na sve Screen Time podatke

rows.en: We only receive anonymized "tokens" that represent apps
rows.value: Primamo samo anonimne "tokene" koji predstavljaju aplikacije

rows.en: When you open or close apps
How long you spend in any app
rows.value: Koliko vremena provodite u bilo kojoj aplikaciji

rows.en: The actual names of apps you select (only tokens)
All your data is stored on your device using Apple's secure storage mechanisms:
rows.value: Svi vaši podaci čuvaju se na vašem uređaju korišćenjem Apple-ovih sigurnih mehanizama za čuvanje:

rows.en: — Your primary GitHub username (for persistence across reinstalls)
rows.value: — Vaše primarno GitHub korisničko ime (za očuvanje pri ponovnim instalacijama)

rows.en: — Shared data between app and extensions
rows.value: — Deljeni podaci između aplikacije i proširenja

rows.en: This data is encrypted by iOS and protected by your device passcode. If you delete the app, your local data is deleted too.
rows.value: Ovi podaci su šifrovani od strane iOS-a i zaštićeni šifrom vašeg uređaja. Ako obrišete aplikaciju, vaši lokalni podaci se takođe brišu.

rows.en: GitFocus does not use any third-party analytics, crash reporting, or advertising services. We don't integrate with:
rows.value: GitFocus ne koristi bilo kakve servise trećih strana za analitiku, izveštavanje o padu ili oglašavanje. Ne integrišemo se sa:
Bilo kojim servisima za praćenje korisnika

rows.en: The only external services we communicate with are github.com to fetch your public contribution data, and our optional customer support chat (see below).
rows.value: Jedini spoljni servisi sa kojima komuniciramo su github.com za preuzimanje vaših javnih podataka o doprinosu i naš opcioni čet za korisničku podršku (videti dole).

rows.en: Contacting support is entirely optional and only happens when you choose to reach out for help.
rows.value: Kontaktiranje podrške je potpuno opciono i dešava se samo kada odlučite da zatražite pomoć.

rows.en: GitFocus offers customer support via live chat powered by Chatwoot, a third-party customer support platform. This is the only third-party service used by GitFocus (besides GitHub), and it's only active when you explicitly choose to contact us for help.
rows.value: GitFocus nudi korisničku podršku preko četa koji pokreće Chatwoot, platforma treće strane za korisničku podršku. Ovo je jedini servis treće strane koji koristi GitFocus (pored GitHub-a), i aktivan je samo kada eksplicitno odlučite da nas kontaktirate za pomoć.

rows.en: Chatwoot uses cookies to maintain your chat session across visits, so you can continue previous conversations
rows.value: Chatwoot koristi cookies da održava vašu čet sesiju između poseta, tako da možete nastaviti prethodne razgovore

rows.en: You can chat with support without providing any personal information - the session is tracked via browser cookies only
rows.value: Možete razgovarati sa podrškom bez pružanja ličnih informacija - sesija se prati samo preko cookies pregledača

rows.en: You may optionally provide your email address if you want to receive follow-up responses
rows.value: Možete opciono navesti vašu adresu e-pošte ako želite da primate sledeće odgovore

rows.en: When you use the chat feature, Chatwoot may collect:
rows.value: Kada koristite funkciju četa, Chatwoot može prikupljati:

rows.en: Your chat messages and conversation history
rows.value: Vaše poruke u četu i istoriju razgovora

rows.en: Email address (only if you choose to provide it)
rows.value: Adresu e-pošte (samo ako odlučite da je navedete)
Osnovne tehničke informacije (tip pregledača, vremenska oznaka)

rows.en: The chat feature does NOT have access to your GitHub data, focus session history, or any other data stored in the GitFocus app. Only the information you explicitly type into the chat is sent to our support system.
rows.value: Funkcija četa NEMA pristup vašim GitHub podacima, istoriji sesija fokusiranja ili bilo kojim drugim podacima pohranjenim u GitFocus aplikaciji. Samo informacije koje eksplicitno ukucate u čet šalju se našem sistemu podrške.

rows.en: Chatwoot is GDPR-compliant and processes data in accordance with applicable data protection laws. For more information, visit
rows.value: Chatwoot je usklađen sa GDPR-om i obrađuje podatke u skladu sa primenljivim zakonima o zaštiti podataka. Za više informacija, posetite

rows.en: You can clear chat cookies at any time through your browser settings. If you never use the chat feature, no data is ever sent to Chatwoot.
rows.value: Možete obrisati cookies četa u bilo kom trenutku preko podešavanja pregledača. Ako nikada ne koristite funkciju četa, nikakvi podaci se ne šalju na Chatwoot.

rows.en: Since we don't collect your data, traditional data rights (access, deletion, portability) don't really apply. But here's what you can do:
rows.value: Pošto ne prikupljamo vaše podatke, tradicionalna prava na podatke (pristup, brisanje, prenosivost) zapravo se ne primenjuju. Ali evo šta možete uraditi:

rows.en: — Simply delete the app from your device
rows.value: — Jednostavno obrišite aplikaciju sa vašeg uređaja

rows.en: — Your data lives on your device; you own it
rows.value: — Vaši podaci su na vašem uređaju; pripadaju vam

rows.en: — All preferences can be modified in the app
rows.value: — Sve preferencije mogu se menjati u aplikaciji

rows.en: on the App Store and is suitable for users of all ages. The app contains no objectionable content, in-app purchases, or social features.
rows.value: u App Store-u i pogodan je za korisnike svih uzrasta. Aplikacija ne sadrži neprihvatljiv sadržaj, kupovine u aplikaciji ili društvene funkcije.

rows.en: Since we don't collect any personal data, there are no special privacy concerns for younger users. However, we recommend that children under 13 set up the app with parental guidance, as:
rows.value: Pošto ne prikupljamo bilo kakve lične podatke, ne postoje posebne brige o privatnosti za mlađe korisnike. Međutim, preporučujemo da deca ispod 13 godina podese aplikaciju uz roditeljski nadzor, jer:

rows.en: Initial setup requires a GitHub username
rows.value: Početno podešavanje zahteva GitHub korisničko ime

rows.en: Screen Time permissions need to be granted by the device owner
rows.value: Screen Time dozvole moraju dati vlasnici uređaja

rows.en: Understanding the commit-based unlock system may need explanation
rows.value: Razumevanje sistema otključavanja zasnovanog na commit-ovima može zahtevati objašnjenje

rows.en: Parents and guardians can use GitFocus as a tool to encourage coding habits in young developers.
rows.value: Roditelji i staratelji mogu koristiti GitFocus kao alat za podsticanje navika programiranja kod mladih programera.

rows.en: If we ever change our privacy practices, we'll update this page with a new "Last Updated" date. Given our no-data-collection approach, significant changes are unlikely.
rows.value: Ako ikada promenimo naše prakse privatnosti, ažuriraćemo ovu stranicu sa novim datumom "Poslednje ažuriranje". S obzirom na naš pristup bez prikupljanja podataka, značajne promene su malo verovatne.

rows.en: Questions about privacy? We're happy to explain anything in more detail.
rows.value: Pitanja o privatnosti? Rado ćemo objasniti bilo šta detaljnije.

rows.en: GitFocus accessibility commitment. VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, Dark Mode, Reduce Motion, and more.
rows.value: GitFocus accessibility commitment. VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, Dark Mode, Reduce Motion, and more.

rows.en: GitFocus is designed for assistive technologies. Accessibility claims are rechecked for each release with automated tests and a human device checklist.
rows.value: GitFocus je dizajniran za pomoćne tehnologije. Tvrdnje o pristupačnosti se ponovo proveravaju za svako izdanje automatizovanim testovima i listom provere na stvarnom uređaju.

rows.en: Key release routes use descriptive labels, traits, and a logical reading order. The release gate records the tested routes and device.
rows.value: Ključne rute izdanja koriste opisne oznake, osobine i logičan redosled čitanja. Kontrola izdanja beleži testirane rute i uređaj.

rows.en: Interactive controls use accessible names. A physical-device checklist verifies the critical release journey with Voice Control.
rows.value: Interaktivne kontrole koriste pristupačna imena. Lista provere na fizičkom uređaju verifikuje kritičan put izdanja sa Voice Control-om.

rows.en: App text uses Dynamic Type. Automated AX3 and AX5 coverage plus a human 200% text-size check are required before this claim is approved.
rows.value: Tekst aplikacije koristi Dynamic Type. Automatizovano pokrivanje AX3 i AX5 plus provera veličine teksta od 200% od strane čoveka su potrebni pre nego što se ova tvrdnja odobri.

rows.en: The app supports light and dark appearances. Both are included in screenshot and app accessibility release checks.
rows.value: Aplikacija podržava svetli i tamni izgled. Oba su uključena u provere snimaka ekrana i pristupačnosti aplikacije pri izdanju.

rows.en: Release review checks that important states use labels, shapes, or icons alongside color.
rows.value: Pregled izdanja proverava da važna stanja koriste oznake, oblike ili ikone pored boje.

rows.en: Automated contrast checks flag candidate failures in light and dark mode; a reviewer verifies the real text, icons, and backgrounds before approval.
rows.value: Automatizovane provere kontrasta označavaju potencijalne probleme u svetlom i tamnom režimu; recenzent verifikuje stvarni tekst, ikone i pozadine pre odobravanja.

rows.en: The release checklist verifies that important motion respects the Reduce Motion preference or has a static alternative.
rows.value: Lista provere izdanja verifikuje da važna kretanja poštuju podešavanje "Smanji kretanje" ili imaju statičku alternativu.

rows.en: Supported flows include keyboard-accessible controls and alternatives for important gesture-only actions.
rows.value: Podržani tokovi uključuju kontrole pristupačne sa tastature i alternative za važne radnje koje se obavljaju samo gestovima.

rows.en: Declared release routes are launched serially in light and dark mode and checked with iOS native accessibility audits. Required audit categories fail the release gate.
rows.value: Deklarisane rute izdanja se pokreću serijski u svetlom i tamnom režimu i proveravaju nativnim iOS revizijama pristupačnosti. Obavezne kategorije revizije zaustavljaju izdanje pri neuspehu.

rows.en: Declared routes are rendered at AX3 and AX5 and checked for crash-free rendering, accessible elements, and route completion.
rows.value: Deklarisane rute se renderuju pri AX3 i AX5 i proveravaju za renderovanje bez pada, pristupačne elemente i završetak rute.

rows.en: Key screens are checked to ensure VoiceOver traversal follows a logical top-to-bottom order, with tolerance for system chrome elements.
rows.value: Ključni ekrani se proveravaju da bi se osiguralo da prolaz VoiceOver-a sledi logičan redosled odozgo nadole, sa tolerancijom za sistemske elemente interfejsa.

rows.en: API checks declared release routes for missing labels, undersized touch targets, and Dynamic Type issues.
rows.value: API checks declared release routes for missing labels, undersized touch targets, and Dynamic Type issues.

rows.en: — Each screen is launched at accessibility text sizes AX3 and AX5 to verify nothing crashes, truncates unreadably, or becomes unreachable.
rows.value: — Svaki ekran se pokreće sa veličinama teksta pristupačnosti AX3 i AX5 da bi se proverilo da se ništa ne ruši, ne skraćuje nečitljivo ili ne postaje nedostupno.

rows.en: — Automated tests verify that VoiceOver traverses elements in logical top-to-bottom order on key screens.
rows.value: — Automatizovani testovi verifikuju da VoiceOver prolazi kroz elemente u logičnom redosledu odozgo nadole na ključnim ekranima.

rows.en: — WCAG contrast evidence is generated from renderer-owned semantic regions, then reviewed against the actual light and dark artwork.
rows.value: — WCAG dokazi o kontrastu se generišu iz semantičkih regiona u vlasništvu renderera, zatim se pregledaju u odnosu na stvarnu svetlu i tamnu grafiku.

rows.en: — The accessibility suites run before screenshot or metadata upload and retain machine-readable evidence.
rows.value: — Skupovi testova pristupačnosti se izvršavaju pre otpremanja snimaka ekrana ili metapodataka i zadržavaju dokaze čitljive mašinama.

rows.en: WCAG 2.1 Level AA contrast targets for text and interactive elements
rows.value: WCAG 2.1 nivo AA ciljevi kontrasta za tekst i interaktivne elemente

rows.en: Apple Human Interface Guidelines for accessibility
rows.value: Apple smernice za korisnički interfejs za pristupačnost

rows.en: Minimum 44pt touch-target checks for interactive controls
rows.value: Provera minimalne veličine oblasti dodira od 44pt za interaktivne kontrole

rows.en: Semantic Dynamic Type coverage at accessibility text sizes
rows.value: Semantičko pokrivanje Dynamic Type-a pri veličinama teksta pristupačnosti

rows.en: VoiceOver-compatible labels and traits on every interactive element
rows.value: Oznake i osobine kompatibilne sa VoiceOver-om na svakom interaktivnom elementu

rows.en: Keyboard-accessible alternatives for all gesture-based interactions
rows.value: Alternative pristupačne sa tastature za sve interakcije zasnovane na gestovima

rows.en: If you encounter any accessibility barriers while using GitFocus, we want to hear about it so we can fix it.
rows.value: Ako naiđete na bilo kakve barijere pristupačnosti dok koristite GitFocus, želimo da čujemo o tome tako da možemo to da popravimo.
